purpose: Durable, resumable product production queue. One record per product. Resume from this file + referenced evidence after any interruption.

queue_policy.move_on_rule: A product reaching READY_FOR_AUTHORIZATION (or BLOCKED) does not stop the queue; the next eligible product is selected immediately.
queue_policy.authorization_rule: Publication authorization is per-product and never inferred. Phrase to publish B12-001 was 'APPROVE B12-001 PUBLISH' and applies to B12-001 only.
queue_policy.quality_bar: No product may be marked QA_PASSED without: structural inspection, formula/output arithmetic verification, an independent inspection of the final deliverable, listing-to-deliverable consistency, and a re-test after every repair.
queue_policy.evidence_rule: Demand/price claims must cite real, dated sources (OBSERVED) or are marked DERIVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN. No invented demand.
queue_policy.spend_rule: TOTAL_NEW_SPEND=$0. No paid APIs, ads, or purchased traffic.
queue_policy.dedup_rule: Before creating a new product, check existing products and rejected candidates for an overlap in problem, audience, workflow, or outcome.
